description: The SPA now loads from the plugin-served OTA origin lvsync://localhost/app/ (so the web hot-updates without an app reinstall). That origin needs its OWN core:default for the IPC layer plus the haptics + opener grants — a capability is matched per origin, and the local 'default' capability covers tauri://localhost, not this custom scheme. Same grants as default/remote-haptics, scoped to the lvsync app origin.
